product_family: AI writing assistant for fiction (consumer SaaS web app + mobile, plus 1,000+ community Plugins and a proprietary Muse model)

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: No SOC 2 claim found anywhere on the vendor's site. /security, /trust, /trust-center, /compliance all return 'Page not found'.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 27001 claim found on any vendor page.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: If you are a resident of the European Economic Area (EEA), you have certain data protection rights and the Operator aims to take reasonable steps to allow you to correct, amend, delete, or limit the use of your Personal Information.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Consumer fiction-writing tool with no health-data scope; no HIPAA claim made and none applicable.

privacy.ai_training_note: Sudowrite states it does not train AI models on user writing. FAQ direct quote: 'We do not use your writing to train AI models.' Founder Amit Gupta has separately stated 'No manuscripts were used to train the AI as we have not done any training.' Generation is powered by third-party LLM providers (e.g. OpenAI enterprise API, which contractually does not retain or train on submitted data) plus Sudowrite's own 'Muse' fiction model. Any review of user content for model fine-tuning is described as optional and consent-based.
privacy.data_region: unknown (US-based company governed by California law; privacy policy notes cross-border transfers may occur but does not specify a hosting region)

security.name: Stated safeguards
security.value: Reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards claimed, but no specifics (no named encryption standard, key management, or access-control detail in the policy).

security.name: Encryption
security.value: unknown / not stated in policy. Third-party reviews mention 'industry-standard encryption' but this is not asserted on a vendor-owned security page.

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: None found (no HackerOne or Bugcrowd program).

security.name: Data breach handling
security.value: Privacy policy includes a 'Data breach' notification clause.

security.name: Content ownership
security.value: User retains all rights to Your Content; Sudowrite takes only a non-exclusive license to host/process to provide the service, with no right to sell or distribute it.

products.name: Sudowrite (web/mobile app, subscription tiers)
products.data_scope: User-authored manuscripts, characters, worldbuilding, account info (name, email, Google-linked account). Content processed via third-party LLMs to generate suggestions.
products.notes: Core consumer product. $10/month entry tier with monthly credit allocation. Not trained on. 18+ required.

products.name: Muse (proprietary fiction model)
products.data_scope: Same user manuscript content sent for generation.
products.notes: Sudowrite's own model built for fiction; marketed as Muse 1.5. Training corpus not disclosed but vendor states user writing is not used to train it.

products.name: Plugins (1,000+ community/user-built)
products.data_scope: User content passed into selected plugins.
products.notes: Users can build and run third-party-authored plugins; introduces additional prompt-routing surface but governed by same account/privacy terms.

products.name: Free Tools (story/plot/name generators)
products.notes: Marketing funnel tools; minimal data scope.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription (monthly credits; entry ~$10/month, free trial, no card needed). Optional non-expiring credit purchases.

flags: No security/trust/compliance page exists (all such URLs 404).
No enterprise certifications (SOC 2 / ISO 27001) claimed or found - normal for a small consumer startup.
Privacy policy is a generic template with broad language; covers GDPR/CCPA rights but lacks vendor-specific security detail (no named encryption standard, no DPA reference).
No bug bounty or pentest evidence.
Strong positive: vendor explicitly states it does NOT train on user writing, and Terms grant only a limited service-provision license over user content.
